reasoning_details.summary:
**Clarifying technical requirements**

I’m thinking about ensuring the repository is available and that versions are managed properly. The JSON format has to be valid and free of markdown.

I want to clarify activity descriptions, especially for a “single developer” environment, and include testing.

I’ll consider technical design choices without being too specific — like using Spring Boot mechanisms, lazy context, metrics, and cloud configuration. Also, I’ll make sure to mention backward compatibility and aim for valid JSON.

technical_and_design_decisions: Use the existing Spring XD module, admin, container, messaging, and build conventions wherever possible rather than introducing a new application architecture.

Implement job-module lazy initialization by creating the module application context at job launch and closing it on successful, failed, or cancelled completion, with lifecycle cleanup handled in a finally-equivalent path.
Use Spring Boot Actuator's metric repository and export APIs as the primary integration point for module and application-specific metrics.
Manage module options through Spring Boot property sources and configuration metadata, retaining compatibility mappings for existing Spring XD option names where practical.
Use a centralized external configuration service based on Spring configuration property sources, with server-side and client-side integration for XD-Admin and XD-Container.

Treat Spark streaming tap support and Reliable receiver information as changes to examples, integration coverage, and user documentation unless existing APIs reveal a missing implementation capability.
Investigate Rabbit performance with repeatable load tests, broker and client metrics, profiling, and targeted configuration or code changes rather than making unvalidated tuning changes.
Migrate master-branch CI execution to reproducible EC2-based build agents, keeping build orchestration and test commands functionally equivalent to the existing CI process.
Use Java 17-compatible implementation and test configurations consistent with the stated Spring Framework baseline.
Include automated unit, integration, regression, and documentation/example verification in the increment before final delivery.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD source repository, build infrastructure, CI definitions, and test environments are available and buildable by one developer.
The increment covers all eight user stories, including implementation where needed and documentation or infrastructure changes where the story is primarily informational.
No major upgrade of Spring XD, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Spark, or the CI platform is required beyond compatibility changes directly caused by the work.
Existing module, job, metrics, configuration, messaging, and CI abstractions are sufficiently usable that the work does not require a framework rewrite.

The centralized configuration service may use an established Spring-compatible configuration-server pattern; high-availability production operations, secret-management integration, and organization-wide rollout are out of scope.

Performance benchmarks will cover representative supported deployment scenarios and will document hardware, operating system, JVM, broker, data sizes, workload, and measured results; exhaustive hardware coverage is out of scope.
Rabbit performance work includes diagnosis and one or more validated corrective changes, but not a complete redesign of the messaging subsystem.
EC2 migration includes instance provisioning or configuration, security and access setup, CI agent registration, build execution, and documentation, but not long-term operations staffing.
Effort is for one developer and is expressed as productive workdays; elapsed calendar time, waiting for external approvals, and third-party service provisioning delays are excluded.
Estimates include normal code review preparation, local verification, and defect correction within the affected scope.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the repository, identify affected modules and build profiles, reproduce the current behavior for jobs, metrics, configuration, Spark examples, Rabbit messaging, and CI, and establish a test and benchmark baseline.

Define representative Spring XD cluster workloads, create or adapt repeatable benchmark scripts and scenarios, capture infrastructure and JVM details, run the benchmarks, validate results, and publish the benchmark procedure and results.

Trace deployment and launch lifecycle behavior, define context ownership, startup and shutdown states, failure handling, concurrency expectations, and compatibility behavior for lazy job-module bootstrapping.

Change job module deployment and launch processing so that the application context is created only when a job runs and is closed after completion, including cleanup for failures, cancellation, and repeated launches.
Add unit and integration tests for deferred startup, successful completion, failure and cancellation cleanup, repeated execution, resource release, and regression coverage for non-job modules.

activities.activity_name: Spark streaming tap and Reliable receiver examples and documentation
activities.activity_description: Verify or add the supported tap-at-output example for Spark streaming, update runnable examples and configuration, document Spark streaming capabilities, and expand Reliable receiver guidance with limitations and operational considerations.

Map module and application-specific metrics to the Spring Boot Actuator metric repository/export API, implement registration and consumption paths, preserve useful metric naming and tags, and add tests for metric publication and retrieval.

activities.activity_name: Spring Boot property-source module option management
activities.activity_description: Replace or adapt core-runtime classpath option maintenance with Spring Boot property-source resolution, add configuration metadata generation or metadata files, handle precedence and defaults, and test module option discovery and injection.

Design and implement the central configuration integration, including server-side configuration exposure, XD-Admin client support, XD-Container client support, environment/profile selection, refresh or startup loading behavior, error handling, and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Rabbit message-bus performance investigation and correction
activities.activity_description: Create reproducible Rabbit workload tests, collect broker, client, JVM, and application measurements, isolate likely bottlenecks, implement targeted configuration or code improvements, and validate throughput, latency, and resource usage against the baseline.

Configure EC2 build agents and access, migrate master-branch CI jobs and required dependencies, preserve build and test behavior, add agent lifecycle or cleanup configuration, validate representative and failure scenarios, and document operation.

Run the complete build and affected integration suites, verify interactions among lifecycle, metrics, property sources, external configuration, messaging, and examples, diagnose regressions, and apply fixes.

activities.activity_name: Final documentation, packaging, and delivery preparation
activities.activity_description: Consolidate configuration instructions, benchmark infrastructure details, migration notes, operational guidance, test evidence, release notes, and final packaging or contribution artifacts for all completed stories.
